Picodash

Picodash is a React package family for adding configurable controls, readouts, visualizations, and
movable tool panels to existing applications.

Status:
- Store target contract and API: accepted.
- DashPanel target contract: reviewed provisional draft; exact prop/type and CSS inventories remain.
- DashList target contract: draft.
- Picodash integration contract: draft and deferred until foundations stabilize.
- Current source and tests: working prototypes, not automatic compatibility requirements.
- Product implementation: paused during contract review.

Products:
- @picodash/store: framework-independent typed values, atomic validation, scoped metadata,
  persistence, import/export, diagnostics, and external-value adapters.
- @picodash/store/react: public React hooks and typed selectors.
- @picodash/store/integration: advanced shared context and declarative lifecycle leases.
- @picodash/dashpanel: standalone DashPanelProvider and DashPanel shell with configurable docking.
- @picodash/dashlist: standalone List, group, Dashlet, binding, and reorder composition.
- @picodash/picodash: integrated facade after Store, DashPanel, and DashList stabilize.
- @picodash/theme: shared semantic theme tokens and context.

Authoritative documents:
- AGENTS.md: workspace rules, glossary, documentation precedence, QA, and commands.
- docs/product/value-propositions.md: product purpose and boundaries.
- docs/ROADMAP.md: implementation and dogfooding sequence.
- docs/adr/0002-provider-level-store-and-scoped-views.md: Store architecture.
- docs/reference/store-contract-decisions.md: searchable accepted Store decisions.
- docs/reference/store.md: accepted Store target API.
- docs/reference/dashpanel.md: draft DashPanel target.
- docs/reference/dashlist.md: draft DashList target.
- docs/reference/picodash.md: draft integration target.
- docs/reference/document-status.md: contract versus implementation labels.
- docs/reference/contract-conformance.md: test ownership and release gates.
- TESTING.md: test-layer policy.

Core Store contract:
- One root owns canonical field values and durable scope metadata.
- root.scope(scopeId) returns an immutable view of the same authority.
- Scopes organize trusted state and attribution; they do not restrict field access.
- Snapshots contain immutable data and commands live on Store APIs.
- Binding input uses parse, Standard Schema canonicalization, and validation. Other sources skip the
  UI parser and use schema plus validation.
- Store-owned mode persists permitted application values and Picodash metadata.
- External-owned mode uses one synchronous root adapter and persists Picodash metadata only.
- Persistence, document, repair, overwrite, and prune recovery use explicit root-owned plans.
- DashPanel and DashList register active entities and relationships through declarative leases.
- DashPanel dock occupancy and allocation are transient Provider runtime; Store persists only
  settled placement and preferred boundary-relative free position.
- Imperative Panel deregistration is retired.

Workspace applications:
- apps/web: production evaluation website; / is the only public route.
- apps/lab: local Contract Lab at /lab and checked-in visual audit reports.

Verification:
- bun install
- vp check
- vp run -r test
- vp run -r build
- bun run test:e2e:lab:cap
- bun run test:e2e:lab
- bun run test:e2e:web
- bun run ready

Run the narrowest owning check first. Use browser tests only for behavior requiring a real browser.
